headings.strategy: Expressive and modern. Use tracking-tight for H1 and H2. Do NOT use Inter. For the main tagline, use font-black.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible body text that inherently connects to the Jakarta theme. Use leading-relaxed for paragraphs.

landing_page.hero: Asymmetric split or Bento grid. Left: Text block with H1 (Outfit text-5xl tracking-tight), primary CTA (green), secondary CTA (gold). Right/Background: Jakarta cityscape with light overlay. Soft floating stats cards (glassmorphism) overlapping the image.
landing_page.timeline: Vertical stepper layout, distinct active (primary green) vs inactive (gray) states.
landing_page.about_stats: Dense bento grid for statistics, large numbers (text-5xl text-primary) with muted labels.
landing_page.spacing: Generous. Use py-20 or py-24 for main sections. gap-8 or gap-12 between grid items.

auth_pages.container: Split screen. Left: Authentication form inside a clean white card (rounded-2xl) centered in a light gray/green-tinted pane. Right: Beautiful imagery of students studying with a primary green transparent overlay and the BAZNAS/MDJ branding.
auth_pages.social_login: Outlined button for Google login with standard icon, distinct from primary action.

dashboards_general.structure: Sidebar navigation (240px wide on desktop) + Top header (user profile/notifications) + Main content area.
dashboards_general.sidebar_active_state: bg-primary/10 text-primary-hover font-semibold rounded-lg with a left 4px solid border of #27AE60.
dashboards_general.page_header: H2 title, breadcrumbs, and primary action button (e.g., 'Upload Document' or 'Export Data') top right.

student_dashboard.widgets: Profile completion progress bar (green fill). Status tracker (Pending -> Verified -> Approved). Document upload grid.

admin_pendaftaran_dashboard.data_table: Dense grid layout for table. Stick to text-sm. Include inline status badges (Green = Approved, Yellow = Pending, Red = Rejected). Quick-action dropdowns in the last column.

super_admin_dashboard.analytics: Top row: 4 summary cards (Total Registrants, Verified, Pending, Total Admins). Followed by recharts/Shadcn charts for registration trends over time.
super_admin_dashboard.content_management: Forms for uploading banners and editing timelines should use Shadcn forms with rich text/file upload components.

component_instructions.buttons: Always explicitly define hover text colors. Use pill-shaped (rounded-full) for landing page CTAs, and rounded-xl for dashboard actions.
component_instructions.cards: Avoid overusing card borders. Rely on the subtle green-tinted shadow and rounded-2xl corners to separate from the #F9FAFB background.
component_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Ensure clear horizontal lines but avoid vertical lines for a cleaner, modern look.
component_instructions.badges: Status badges must use tint colors (e.g., bg-[#E8F6EE] text-[#0B6B3A] for success/active).
component_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react exclusively. Standardize icon sizes (e.g., w-5 h-5 for buttons, w-6 h-6 for sidebar).

motion.hover: Subtle transform (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on cards. Color fade on buttons (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.page_transition: Simple fade-in (opacity-0 to opacity-100) using framer-motion if possible, or simple CSS animations.
motion.accordions: Use Shadcn accordion for FAQs with smooth height expansion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #1F2937 text on all #F2C94C backgrounds. Ensure #FFFFFF text on #27AE60 backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-label on icon-only buttons (like the sidebar toggler or action dropdowns).

image_urls.description: Jakarta Selamat Datang Monument with skyscrapers, ideal for the hero section background to root the app in Jakarta context.
Group of diverse students studying and smiling. Great for the 'About Program' or 'Registration' section.
Students collaborating over a laptop. Ideal for the split-screen image on the login and register pages.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You have .js files not .tsx files. Write React components using .jsx/.js.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans'. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use backdrop-blur with semi-transparent white/black.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, dropdown items) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for logic (Tables, Select, Dialog, Calendar), but heavily style them with the MDJ visual identity (green/gold, rounded-xl).
Create depth using layered design elements and subtle, tinted shadows, not harsh black drop-shadows.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications, placed at the top-center or bottom-right.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖💡🎯) as icons.
Maintain the BAZNAS government-charity tone: clean, professional, accessible, and optimistic.
